findings.evidence: Spec worktree-coordination: "kept as a handed-off record with its identity, overlap acknowledgments, handed-off head and PR". design.md: "`agent_board.py hand-off --id <id> --head <sha> --pr <N>` sets `handed_off: {head, pr, at}`". Code: template/scripts/agent_board.py `cmd_hand_off` sets `item["handed_off"] = {"head": args.head, "at": utc_now()}`. The parser (build_parser) defines no `--pr` option. `finish_task.hand_off_board` passes only `--id` and `--head`. `rehandoff_refusal` resolves the PR with `gh pr view <branch>` and never compares it to a recorded PR number. design.md also says acceptance applies "only when the PR it names is open".
findings.summary: The handed-off board record stores only the head and a timestamp, not the PR. The worktree-coordination spec requires the record to keep the handed-off PR, and design.md describes `hand-off --id --head --pr` writing `{head, pr, at}`. Preflight acceptance is also supposed to check that exact PR. It instead looks up whatever PR `gh pr view <branch>` returns.
